2124524321129578713.en_summary: AI CapEx compared to telecom boom, but key is where spending settles after peak. Telecom CapEx intensity fell below start, but $AMZN, $GOOGL, $META, $MSFT from ~12% of revenue pre-AI to projected 24% by 2030 (twice baseline even after 2027 peak). $NBIS, $CRWV, $IREN CapEx intensity projected to peak in 2026, so as revenue catches up, companies crushed by capital requirements could approach cash flow inflection.
2124524321129578713.zh_summary: AI資本支出與電信熱潮相比，但關鍵在於峰值後支出落在何處。電信資本支出強度最終降至起點以下，但$AMZN、$GOOGL、$META、$MSFT從AI前收入約12%升至2030年預計24%（即使2027年峰值後也是舊基準的兩倍）。$NBIS、$CRWV、$IREN的資本支出強度預計2026年已達峰值，因此隨著收入追上支出，因資本需求受壓的公司可能接近現金流拐點。
